name: status-report-reality-check
description: Checks a status report against a ticket export, both pasted into the chat, and lists where the reported status and the tickets disagree: 'on track' while the ticket is blocked or overdue, 'done' while the epic is 27% done, 'green' with nothing touched in weeks. Each disagreement shows the item, what the report says (quoted), what the tickets say (built in code from the export's own cells: status, dates, assignee, children done) and a risk level from fixed rules. Matching, dates and rules run in code; the model only reads the report. Report items with no ticket are listed separately. Follow-ups: only high risk, stale after 7 days, show matched tickets, why was X flagged, as json. It reads only what you paste (CSV/TSV/JSON export), never fetches tickets and never judges people.

skills.name: Status report reality check
skills.description: Lists where a pasted status report and a pasted ticket export disagree (item, reported, evidence, risk), with code-built evidence from the export, plus follow-ups on the same comparison.
examples: Reality-check this status report against this ticket export: Report: <paste> Tickets: <paste the CSV>
